title: Divide Mixed Numbers
contentObjective: I can divide mixed numbers by first changing them to improper fractions.
languageObjective: I can explain my steps using the words mixed number, improper fraction, convert, reciprocal, and simplify.

vocabulary.definition: A whole number plus a fraction, like 2 1/3.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Un número entero más una fracción, como 2 1/3.
vocabulary.visual: 2 1/3 means 2 wholes and 1/3 more — picture 2 full circles and 1/3 of another
vocabulary.cloze: A number with a whole number and a fraction, like 2 1/3, is a ___.

examples.why: It has a whole part (2) and a fraction part (1/3).
That is an improper fraction, not a mixed number.

vocabulary.definitionVi: Một số gồm phần nguyên cộng với một phân số, ví dụ như 2 1/3.
vocabulary.definitionAr: رقم مكوّن من جزء صحيح وجزء كسري، مثل 2 1/3.

vocabulary.definition: A fraction where the top is bigger than or equal to the bottom, like 7/4.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una fracción donde el número de arriba es mayor o igual al de abajo, como 7/4.
vocabulary.visual: 7/3 is improper because 7 > 3. It equals 2 1/3 as a mixed number.
vocabulary.cloze: A fraction whose numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator, like 7/3, is an ___.

examples.why: The numerator 7 is greater than the denominator 3.
The numerator is less than the denominator, so it is a proper fraction.

vocabulary.termVi: Phân số không thực sự (phân số lớn hơn 1)
vocabulary.definitionVi: Phân số có tử số lớn hơn hoặc bằng mẫu số.
vocabulary.definitionAr: كسر يكون فيه البسط أكبر من المقام أو مساوياً له.

vocabulary.definition: To change a number to a new form but keep the same value.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Cambiar un número a otra forma sin cambiar su valor.
vocabulary.visual: 2 1/3 → multiply 2 × 3 = 6, add 1 → 7/3. Same value, different form.
vocabulary.cloze: Changing a mixed number into an improper fraction is to ___ it.
vocabulary.definitionVi: Đổi một số sang dạng khác mà vẫn giữ nguyên giá trị (ví dụ: hỗn số thành phân số không thực sự).
vocabulary.definitionAr: تغيير صورة العدد إلى شكل جديد مع الحفاظ على القيمة نفسها (مثل تحويل عدد كسري إلى كسر غير فعلي).

vocabulary.definition: To make a fraction smaller using the same parts, like 2/4 = 1/2.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Hacer una fracción más pequeña con las mismas partes, como 2/4 = 1/2.
vocabulary.cloze: Writing a fraction in its smallest equal form is to ___ it.
vocabulary.definitionVi: Chia cả tử và mẫu cho ước chung lớn nhất để phân số nhỏ nhất.
vocabulary.definitionAr: تقسيم البسط والمقام على العامل المشترك الأكبر للحصول على أبسط صورة للكسر.

vocabulary.definition: A fraction turned upside down. You use it in keep-change-flip.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una fracción volteada de arriba abajo. Se usa en deja-cambia-voltea.
vocabulary.visual: The reciprocal of 3/4 is 4/3. To divide by 3/4, multiply by 4/3.
vocabulary.cloze: To divide by a fraction, I multiply by its ___.
vocabulary.definitionVi: Số đảo ngược của phân số (ví dụ: nghịch đảo của a/b là b/a).
vocabulary.definitionAr: ناتج قلب الكسر (مثال: مقلوب a/b هو b/a).

conceptIntro.heading: How do I divide with mixed numbers?
conceptIntro.intro: A mixed number, like 3 1/2, has a whole part and a fraction part. Before you can divide, you change each mixed number into an improper fraction (top heavier than bottom). Then you use Keep, Change, Flip.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: Always convert a mixed number to an improper fraction first, then divide using Keep, Change, Flip.

iDo.title: Watch me
lines: Agent Chen has a 3 1/2-mile route cut into 1/4-mile segments. I want 3 1/2 ÷ 1/4.
First I convert 3 1/2. Multiply the whole by the bottom: 3 × 2 = 6. Add the top: 6 + 1 = 7. So 3 1/2 = 7/2.
Now Keep, Change, Flip: keep 7/2, change ÷ to ×, flip 1/4 to 4/1.

weDo.title: Let's try together
lines: Let's try 2 1/2 ÷ 1/2. First convert 2 1/2: 2 × 2 = 4, plus 1 = 5, so 2 1/2 = 5/2.

youDo.title: Now it's your turn
lines: Now fill in the table: convert each mixed number to an improper fraction, then divide using Keep, Change, Flip.

approaching.title: approaching — Spot the Common Mistake
approaching.correctWork: The student forgot to flip the divisor. Keep, Change, Flip means 3/4 becomes 4/3. So 3/2 ÷ 3/4 = 3/2 × 4/3 = 12/6 = 2, not 1 1/8.
hints: Look at the Keep, Change, Flip step — did the divisor get flipped?
To divide by 3/4, multiply by its reciprocal 4/3: 3/2 × 4/3 = 2.

onLevel.stem: A baker has 2 1/4 cups of butter. Each batch of cookies needs 3/4 cup of butter. How many batches can the baker make?
choiceFeedback: That multiplies or adds instead of dividing. To find how many pieces fit, divide.
The dividend (whole being split) comes first. The divisor (piece size) comes second.
Recalculate using division by the fraction, not another operation.

onLevel.title: onLevel — Spot the Common Mistake
onLevel.correctWork: The student divided before converting the mixed number. First convert: 3 1/3 = 10/3. Then 10/3 ÷ 2/3 = 10/3 × 3/2 = 30/6 = 5, not 3 1/2.
hints: Did the student convert 3 1/3 to an improper fraction before dividing?

extending.title: Find the Mixed Number Error
extending.correctWork: 2 1/3 = 7/3 (not 6/3). Multiply: 2 × 3 = 6, then ADD the numerator 1 to get 7. So 7/3 × 2/1 = 14/3 = 4 2/3.
hints: Check the conversion: 2 × 3 = 6, then add the numerator 1 to get 7.
2 1/3 should convert to 7/3, not 6/3. The student forgot to add the numerator.

extending.prompt: A detective has a rope that is 5 1/4 feet long. She needs to cut it into pieces that are each 3/4 foot for tying evidence tags. How many pieces can she cut? Write the equation, show each step (convert, keep-change-flip, multiply, simplify), and verify your answer.
extending.sentenceFrame: First I convert 5 1/4 to ___. Then I use KCF: ___ × ___ = ___. The answer is ___ pieces. I can verify because ___ × 3/4 = 5 1/4.
extending.hint: Compare two different divisions. How are they alike and different? Use a model or example.

extending.title: Find Liam's Mistake
extending.correctWork: Liam forgot to flip the second fraction. 7/2 ÷ 5/4 = 7/2 × 4/5 = 28/10 = 14/5 = 2 4/5.
hints: Look at Step 4. Did Liam flip the divisor before multiplying?
Keep-Change-Flip means the divisor 5/4 becomes 4/5. Liam multiplied by 5/4 instead of 4/5.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake in Divide Mixed Numbers is dividing the whole-number parts and fraction parts separately instead of converting first — for example, treating 4 1/2 ÷ 1 1/2 as (4 ÷ 1) + (1/2 ÷ 1/2) = 5. Always convert each mixed number to one improper fraction first, then divide using Keep, Change, Flip: 4 1/2 ÷ 1 1/2 = 9/2 ÷ 3/2 = 9/2 × 2/3 = 3.
